Based on: E-503

Buyer:
> Hi, we want 20 boxes of stoneware mugs at $40 per box, but we need free shipping and two months to pay.

Seller:
> We cannot do free shipping and two months of waiting on 20 boxes as that loses money.
> Here are three options:
> Option 1 (Standard): 20 boxes at $40 with $20 shipping, due on receipt.
> Option 2 (Quantity): 40 boxes at $40 with FREE shipping, because bigger orders ship together.
> Option 3 (Early payment): 20 boxes at $40 with 10% off if paid within 7 days.

Buyer:
OK, 40 boxes works for us.

Please send the draft invoice.
